component.name: Open Voice Input Linux
Open Voice Input Linux
component.summary: Native inline IBus voice input for Linux
在当前光标处原生输入文字的 Linux 语音输入法

description.p: Open Voice Input Linux sends live speech recognition text to the focused IBus input context without using the clipboard or simulated paste.

This Ubuntu 24.04 preview supports adaptive terminology corrections, per-utterance microphone selection, and optional user-owned ASR data collection. Recognition currently uses the user's Volcengine account.
Open Voice Input Linux 将实时语音识别结果直接写入当前 IBus 输入位置， 不依赖剪贴板或模拟粘贴。
当前 Ubuntu 24.04 预览版支持术语纠错学习、逐句动态选择麦克风和可选的 用户自有 ASR 数据收集；在线识别目前使用用户自己的火山引擎账号。
Ubuntu 24.04 alpha with a standalone Debian package and a Chinese-first project landing page.
